Supply Chain Process Engineer / Project Manager (f/m/d)

- Operations Center Neuenburg 2
- 80% - 100%
- Supply Chain Management
- Englisch

As the top Swiss e-commerce platform, with a crew of over 4'000 across Switzerland, Germany, and Serbia, Galaxus is poised to move into new markets. Our driving force is our determination to keep challenging the status quo. That’s why we’re on the lookout for characters who’re passionate about making genuine improvements. We’ll give you the freedom and trust to make an impact, to grow with us and to be yourself. Act galactic. Be you.

Your journey begins at our established logistics center in Wohlen, Switzerland (2-3 days per week), where you will get to know our processes, culture, and team while contributing to the cross-site project for the new location from day one. Through targeted training, workshops, and close collaboration with experienced colleagues, you will gain the insights and support needed to successfully transition into your role.

This way you experience a fully functioning operation firsthand and actively shape the future in Neuenburg at the same time. During the ramp-up phase, you act as a pragmatic all-rounder: You tackle problems wherever they arise and resolve operational bottlenecks immediately – whether at your desk or on the shop floor.

Deine Aufgaben

- You will develop, design and optimize logistics processes for our new location in Neuenburg
- In Supply Chain Management, you constantly work to improve existing processes, optimally implement new ones, and document them appropriately
- You assess new ideas together with relevant stakeholders, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis
- You ensure proper training, documentation, and correct application of processes by regularly participating in operational logistics activities
- Depending on the situation, you assume different responsibilities during project implementation, including coordinating project teams as a project manager or independently driving optimization initiatives
- You identify optimization opportunities, initiate the necessary actions, and ensure their successful implementation

Deine Fähigkeiten

- A university degree (FH, University, ETH) in Process Management, or a related field, such as Industrial Engineering, Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification
- At least 3 years of professional experience in process development or project management in an industrial or logistics environment; experience with automated systems is an advantage as well as experience with SQL
- Successfully led and implemented projects, ideally combined with experience in Lean Management
- Flexibility to work temporarily in Wohlen and later at the new logistics center in Neuenburg, along with approximately 20% travel within Switzerland
- Fluent in English and German, French is an advantage
- The capacity to adapt to ongoing changes in the work environment
- Identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing changes to enhance productivity and effectiveness

Warum startest du bei uns?

- Values, not empty words: Cooperative, innovative, piratesque, responsible, ambitious – these five values are what we practise and preach
- Courageous thinking: We encourage everyone to think on their feet, and love it when they come up with bold or edgy ideas
- Uncomplicated approach: Simplicity is at our core. We avoid the unnecessary and focus on what really matters – from overcoming challenges to celebrating our shared successes
- Flexibility and freedom: Every position is possible with an 80% workload
- Rapid growth: With us, growth is a continuous journey. We also support you with EDU points (https://www.galaxus.de/en/page/more-training-sign-me-up-20943)  (1600 € and 2000 minutes) per year for your professional development so there’s no risk of you getting stuck in a rut
- More benefits: 28 days of holiday, exclusive employee conditions in our online shop, a shuttle service and other benefits

Diversity is our culture.

To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we believe precision medicine radically improves lives. Our Global CAP/CLIA laboratories are the "heartbeat" of diagnostic innovation, bridging the gap between early research and life-saving commercial diagnostics. As a Laboratory Manager, you aren't just overseeing a facility; you are leading a team that transforms complex biological data into the insights clinicians need to treat patients with cancer and other life-altering diseases.

We are seeking a high-caliber Laboratory Manager (m/f/d) to oversee our dual-specialty pathology and immunoassay laboratory. This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise in tissue-based diagnostics and immunoassay automated testing.

You will be responsible for the operational excellence of the lab, ensuring that both the Histology/Pathology and Immunoassay/Chemistry departments function at peak efficiency while maintaining total compliance with ISO15189, CAP (College of American Pathologists) and CLIA regulations.

The Opportunity

You will oversee a dual-specialty laboratory at the forefront of the industry. Your leadership will span two critical domains:
* Anatomic Pathology: Managing high-complexity tissue-based diagnostics, including advanced Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ Hybridization (ISH)
* Immunoassay Excellence: Driving peaks of operational efficiency in our automated immunoassay tracks on state-of-the-art cobas® platforms

You will also be a key driver in our Digital Pathology transformation, integrating whole-slide imaging and AI-based image analysis into routine clinical workflows to set new standards for diagnostic precision. Your key responsibilities:

* Visionary Operational Leadership: Supervise the daily "rhythm" of the lab, synchronizing pathology and immunoassay workflows to ensure competitive turnaround times (TAT)
* Guardian of Quality: Maintain an "inspection-ready" culture, serving as the primary lead for CAP/CLIA and ISO 15189 audits
* Champion of People: Lead, mentor, and inspire team of Laboratory scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence
* Strategic Technical Oversight: Manage the validation and implementation of new assays and novel platforms, ensuring every piece of equipment is a high-performing component of our diagnostic system
* Innovate & Improve: Actively identify opportunities for workflow optimization and cost-effective management without ever compromising the quality that defines the Roche name

Who you are
* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Clinical Laboratory Science, Medical Technology, or a related Biological Science. A Master’s (MHA/MBA) or PhD is highly preferred.
* Furthermore, you have 5+ years of experience in a clinical laboratory setting
* Proven expertise in both anatomic pathology and automated immunoassay workflows is a distinct advantage
* The ideal candidate isn't just a technical expert; You are a leader who fosters a culture of quality, safety, and continuous improvement with at least 2 years of experience in a leadership role
* You live the Roche mindset by maintaining a track record of zero-deficiency inspections and a passion for navigating the complexities of emerging global regulations

Your Application 

Please submit your updated CV. References and certificates are not required at this stage. Please apply with English application documents. 

Please note that no additional documents can be submitted after your application has been sent.

We look forward to receiving your application and potentially welcoming you to our team!

 

 

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Do you need further support?

Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.occupation: Master's Thesis: Multi-Fidelity Propeller Optimization (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Medizintechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for a Master's student to join our growing Aerodynamics team and carry out a thesis project on the development of a multi-fidelity propeller optimization framework for our hybrid-electric eVTOL aircraft. You will help extend an existing automated propeller design workflow - covering geometry generation, meshing, CFD simulation and post-processing - into a full optimization environment that combines fast Blade Element Momentum Theory (BEMT) predictions, high-fidelity CFD, and aeroacoustics prediction.
Your thesis will directly support propeller designs that perform efficiently across hover, transition and forward flight. The thesis takes around six months and is supervised jointly by our Aerodynamics team and the Chair of Aerodynamics and Fluid Mechanics at the Technical University of Munich (TUM).
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Conduct a literature review on propeller optimization methodologies and multi-fidelity approaches
• Familiarize yourself with two existing frameworks for propeller design optimization: low-fidelity BEMT environment, automated CFD surrogate modeling-based optimization framework
• Integrate aeroacoustics prediction methods, in the form of PSU-WOPWOP, as part of the low-fidelity BEMT framework
• Develop methods and strategies to leverage both frameworks and incorporate them into a combined multi-fidelity optimization framework
• Revise and update the automated geometry generation, CFD simulation execution, and post-processing into a unified workflow
• In the process you will parametrize the propeller design and perform an optimization of a test case eVTOL propeller, generate the pareto-front between efficiency and noise
• Validate low-fidelity predictions against CFD reference solutions
• Conduct optimization studies for representative flight conditions, evaluating solution quality, computational cost and convergence
• Optionally: utilize surrogate models to incorporate feedback from high fidelity model to low fidelity model for improved optimization convergence and acceleration
• Document your methodology and findings in your final thesis report

WHAT YOU BRING
• Are a student of mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, physics or a comparable field, enrolled at TUM and working towards your Master's degree
• Bring familiarity with CAD and CFD software, ideally Siemens NX and Ansys Fluent
• Hold foundational knowledge of aircraft and propulsion aerodynamics
• Have basic knowledge of numerical methods and optimization techniques
• Have strong Python programming skills
• Are able to work independently and collaborate with a team
• Have good written and verbal communication skills in English
• Bring an interest in aeroacoustics and propeller noise prediction

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• have prior exposure to Blade Element Momentum Theory or other low-fidelity aerodynamic methods
• have experience with aeroacoustics prediction methods like PSU-WOPWOP
• have experience with HPC-based simulation workflows
• explore the use of surrogate models to accelerate convergence between fidelity levels

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Resident Quality Engineer (f/m/d), you will spend your day working closely with suppliers, manufacturing teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product quality, production stability, and delivery performance. A significant portion of your role involves being on-site at supplier locations, leading quality escalations, supporting production recovery, and driving sustainable process improvements. You will analyze manufacturing challenges, coordinate corrective actions, conduct audits, and collaborate with engineering and operations teams to strengthen process capability and customer satisfaction. With approximately 25–30% travel, you will play a critical role in maintaining quality excellence across the supply chain.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Deployment to supplier sites as a dedicated quality escalation expert to stabilize production following critical quality, technical, or delivery issues
* Leadership of immediate containment activities to prevent defect escapes, protect customers, and maintain operational continuity
* Development and management of supplier recovery plans including action tracking, milestone management, accountability, and executive reporting
* Execution of root cause analyses, manufacturing process reviews, and quality audits to identify risks, process gaps, and improvement opportunities
* Definition, implementation, validation, and sustainability tracking of corrective and preventive actions to address both short-term and systemic issues
* Collaboration with supplier engineering, quality, and operations teams to improve process capability, product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and long-term performance

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* Extensive experience in quality management, manufacturing environments, supplier quality, and production process improvement
* Strong expertise in root cause analysis, problem-solving methodologies, Kaizen, supplier recovery activities, and critical manufacturing process assessments
* Proven ability to identify technical failure mechanisms, implement sustainable process improvements, and ensure long-term effectiveness of corrective actions
* Experience working in cross-functional and international environments, ideally with turbine hot gas components or other complex manufacturing technologies
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills, combined with fluency in German and English and willingness to travel approximately 25–30% to supplier locations worldwide

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

As a passionate and innovation-driven organization, Siemens Electrification & Automation's Growth Protection team shapes the future of electrical power systems.The Product Manager (f/m/d) – Portfolio Positioning for Protection Relays translates portfolio strategy and product innovations into clear customer value, differentiated positioning, and compelling narratives for successful market adoption. This role acts as a key interface between Product Management and Marketing, aligning product direction, market priorities, and customer needs to ensure a consistent and differentiated market presence. What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of Siemens

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You'll make an impact by

- Translating the SIPROTEC and Reyrolle portfolio strategy into clear customer value propositions, differentiated positioning, and messaging foundations that drive portfolio growth and market success.- Serving as the primary interface between Product Management and Marketing, ensuring alignment between portfolio strategy, commercialization priorities, and market-facing positioning.- Taking responsibility for the successful market introduction of new products and portfolio innovations by defining customer value propositions, differentiation strategies, commercialization approaches, and launch readiness requirements.- Leading the portfolio positioning workstream within cross-functional go-to-market initiatives and driving alignment across Product Management, Market Development, Marketing, and Sales organizations.- Owning and continuously evolving portfolio narratives, customer-value propositions, and competitive positioning based on market insights, customer feedback, and input from Sales, Market Development, and Technical Application teams.- Providing strategic recommendations for portfolio positioning and commercialization decisions to support business growth, market differentiation, and long-term portfolio success.

You excel in

- You hold a university degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Automation Technology, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a comparable educational background.- Several years of experience supporting portfolio commercialization, portfolio positioning, product launches, and value proposition development in Product Management, Portfolio Management, Portfolio Positioning, Market Development, Business Development, technical-commercial strategy, or related commercial functions.- Strong understanding of electrical protection equipment, automation, power systems, substations, or related customer applications.- Proven ability to translate technical product capabilities into compelling customer value propositions, differentiation strategies, and commercial messaging.- Experience leading cross-functional collaboration between Product Management, Marketing, Sales, and Engineering.- Very good command of English (business and negotiation level). Additional language skills are a plus. German language skills are advantageous.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

jobs.occupation: Sales Director (f/m/d) Test & Validation - DACH (Leiter/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Engineering Test & Validation

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation - helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Our Testing business sits at the heart of this transformation. As products become more software-defined, connected, electrified, and complex, manufacturers need to bring together physical testing, data acquisition, simulation, analysis, and engineering software into a connected validation process.
This creates a significant growth opportunity - and we are looking for an exceptional commercial leader to lead it across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH).

The Opportunity
As Test Country Lead (w/m/d) DACH, you will own the commercial success and growth of the Siemens Test business across the region.
You will lead the Sales and PreSales organization while remaining highly visible in the market and directly engaged with strategic customers. This is a player-coach leadership role: you will build and develop a high-performing organization while personally shaping major opportunities, executive relationships, and strategic accounts.
You will spend at least 50% of your time with strategic customers and in the market, ensuring that you remain close to customer priorities, technology trends, competitive dynamics, and the opportunities shaping the future of engineering test and validation.
This is an opportunity to build and grow a significant business in one of the world's most important engineering markets, supported by Siemens' global technology portfolio, resources, and customer relationships.
What you will ownLead the DACH Test Business

- Own the overall commercial performance of the Test business across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.- Drive revenue, growth, profitability, and market-share objectives across hardware, software, maintenance, and customer & engineering services.- Define and execute the regional business strategy and annual operating plan.- Identify new growth opportunities, markets, customers, and routes to market.- Establish clear commercial priorities, KPIs, and accountability across the organization.

Lead from the Market- Personally engage with strategic customers and executive stakeholders, building trusted relationships at C-level and senior engineering levels.- Lead major strategic sales pursuits and complex, multi-year opportunities.- Develop compelling value propositions and quantified business cases that connect technology investment to measurable customer outcomes.- Understand customer engineering and validation challenges and translate them into differentiated Siemens solutions.- Maintain a strong understanding of market trends, competitor strategies, technology shifts, and emerging customer requirements.- Represent Siemens Test at customer events, industry conferences, and executive forums.

Build a High-Performing Sales Organization- Lead, coach, and develop the DACH Sales and PreSales organization.- Recruit and retain exceptional commercial and technical sales talent.- Create a culture of accountability, customer obsession, collaboration, and continuous improvement.- Align individual strengths and expertise with strategic market opportunities.- Establish clear development and succession plans for key roles.- Raise the overall standard of consultative, value-based, and solution-oriented selling.

Win in a Competitive Market- Develop differentiated strategies for strategic accounts and competitive opportunities.- Build strong account and territory plans that increase market penetration and customer value.- Lead competitive positioning across the Test & Validation landscape.- Govern Proof-of-Concept engagements with clear success criteria, commercial objectives, and transition plans.- Develop and manage a high-performing partner ecosystem to extend market reach and accelerate growth.

Connect Customers with Siemens Technology

- Work closely with global Product Management, Industry, Engineering, and Services teams to bring the right solutions to customers.- Ensure that customer feedback and market intelligence directly influence regional and global strategy.- Drive adoption of the broader Siemens portfolio by connecting test, measurement, simulation, engineering software, and services into compelling customer solutions.- Ensure operational excellence through accurate forecasting, disciplined opportunity management, reliable demonstrations, and measurable sales performance.

What You Bring

We are looking for an accomplished Sales Director, Business Leader, or Commercial Leader who combines strong sales leadership with a deep understanding of engineering-driven technology markets, especially in test & validation.

- A successful track record in B2B sales leadership within engineering software, test & measurement, validation, simulation, industrial technology, or a closely related field- Experience leading Sales and PreSales organizations with direct responsibility for regional business performance.- A proven record of winning complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.- Strong experience developing strategic accounts and building long-term relationships with senior engineering and executive decision-makers.- Experience selling solutions such as test & measurement, data acquisition, test automation, validation, simulation, NVH, HIL/XIL, engineering software, or related technologies is highly valuable.- Strong commercial judgment and demonstrated success in negotiations and complex deal structures.- The ability to translate sophisticated technology into clear customer value and compelling business outcomes.- Experience building, coaching, and motivating high-performing sales organizations.- A strong external network and understanding of the DACH engineering and manufacturing ecosystem.- Experience working with strategic partners and developing indirect routes to market.- Strong understanding of industries such as Automotive & Transportation, Aerospace & Defense, Electronics & Semiconductors, Energy, and Industrial Machinery.- Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills.- Willingness to travel regularly across the DACH region and internationally.- Highly proficient spoken and written German and English.

Why Us

We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across many countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Our Benefits & Rewards

The primary locations for this opportunity are Austria, Germany, and Switzerland. The applicable salary ranges for these locations are:
Austria: €162,200 – €308,300
Germany: €145,500 – €291,000

Switzerland: CHF 249,900 – CHF 437,200

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation with 50% of this being comprised of an annual incentive target (100% achievement). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/ (https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/)

This position may also be posted in additional locations beyond those specified above. For such locations, the applicable salary ranges and benefits will be disclosed by the Talent Acquisition Partner at the time of initial contact, in accordance with local legal requirements.

Equal Opportunities

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privilege(...)
